value.Name: Reply-all storm detected
value.Comment: This alert is triggered when a reply-all storm is detected and at least one reply-all to the mail thread has been blocked. See the Reply-all Storm Protection mail flow report for more information. -V1.0.0.0

value.Identity: FFO.extest.microsoft.com/Microsoft Exchange Hosted Organizations/f00ed340-8f84-4eb4-83f3-0075a22b262e/Configuration/Messages have been delayed
value.Name: Messages have been delayed
value.Comment: When Office 365 can't deliver a message to your on-premises or partner servers via a connector, the message is queued in Office 365. This alert is triggered when the number of queued messages exceeds the policy threshold and have been queued for more than an hour. -V1.0.0.0
